ucs.title: [LLM] Famous Chollima 'Contagious Interview' — node.exe spawning Python that touches browser/crypto-wallet artifacts (BeaverTail → InvisibleFerret
ucs.description: Hunts the signature DPRK 'Contagious Interview' chain where a fake-job-coding-challenge npm/Node payload (BeaverTail, JS) drops and executes the Python InvisibleFerret stealer to exfiltrate browser credentials, session cookies, and crypto-wallet (MetaMask/Solana/Exodus/Phantom) keystores. CrowdStrike attributes this kill chain specifically to Famous Chollima (a.k.a. UNC4034 / DEV-0228 ecosystem; related Microsoft cluster: Sapphire Sleet for the developer-targeting variant).
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as command_lines values(Processes.process_hash) as sha256 values(Processes.parent_process) as parent_cmd from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.parent_process_name IN ("node.exe","npm.cmd","npx.cmd","yarn.cmd","pnpm.cmd") AND Processes.process_name IN ("python.exe","pythonw.exe","curl.exe","powershell.exe") AND (Processes.process="*Google\\Chrome\\User Data*" OR Processes.process="*Edge\\User Data*" OR Processes.process="*Login Data*" OR Processes.process="*Local State*" OR Processes.process="*metamask*" OR Processes.process="*MetaMask*" OR Processes.process="*Solana*" OR Processes.process="*Exodus*" OR Processes.process="*Phantom*" OR Processes.process="*Keychain*" OR Processes.process="*\\.ssh\\id_*") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name | `drop_dm_object_name("Processes")` | where user!="SYSTEM" AND NOT match(user,"\$$") | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
ucs.kql:
// Famous Chollima BeaverTail → InvisibleFerret stealer chain
let WalletAndBrowserIOCs = dynamic([
    "AppData\\Local\\Google\\Chrome\\User Data",
    "AppData\\Local\\Microsoft\\Edge\\User Data",
    "AppData\\Roaming\\Exodus",
    "AppData\\Roaming\\MetaMask",
    "Login Data",
    "Local State",
    "metamask", "MetaMask",
    "solana", "Solana",
    "phantom", "Phantom",
    "keystore",
    "Library\\Keychains"
]);
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("node.exe","npm.cmd","npx.cmd","yarn.cmd","pnpm.cmd")
| where FileName in~ ("python.exe","pythonw.exe","curl.exe","powershell.exe","cmd.exe")
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any (WalletAndBrowserIOCs)
   or ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)(requests\.(get|post)|urllib|http[s]?://[a-z0-9\-\.]+:\d{2,5}/(api|upload|client))"
| where AccountName !endswith "$"  // exclude machine accounts
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          ParentCmd   = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ChildImage  = FolderPath,
          ChildCmd    = ProcessCommandLine,
          SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc

    "MetaMask", "metamask",
    "Solana", "solana",

ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Famous Chollima Contagious Interview - Node Spawning Python Targeting Browser and Crypto Wallets
id: 9c8e3b14-2f5d-4a91-bc77-d6f2e7a40118
status: experimental
description: Detects BeaverTail JavaScript loader executed via npm/Node spawning Python (InvisibleFerret) that touches browser credential stores or crypto-wallet directories - the signature DPRK 'Contagious Interview' chain.
references:
  - https://www.crowdstrike.com/en-us/blog/two-birds-one-stone-an-analysis-of-chollimas-stealers-and-rats/
  - https://unit42.paloaltonetworks.com/contagious-interview-lazarus-developers/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/16
tags:
  - attack.initial_access
  - attack.t1195.001
  - attack.execution
  - attack.t1059.006
  - attack.t1059.007
  - attack.credential_access
  - attack.t1555.003
  - attack.t1539
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\node.exe'
      - '\npm.cmd'
      - '\npx.cmd'
      - '\yarn.cmd'
      - '\pnpm.cmd'
  selection_child:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\python.exe'
      - '\pythonw.exe'
  selection_target_artifacts:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'MetaMask'
      - 'metamask'
      - 'Solana'
      - 'Exodus'
      - 'Phantom'
      - 'Login Data'
      - 'Local State'
      - 'Chrome\User Data'
      - 'Edge\User Data'
      - 'Keychain'
      - 'keystore'
  condition: selection_parent and selection_child and selection_target_artifacts
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate Node-based developer tooling wrapping Python utilities that incidentally touch browser profiles (rare)
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @ParentImage:(*\\node.exe OR *\\Node.exe OR *\\NODE.EXE OR *\\npm.cmd OR *\\npx.cmd OR *\\yarn.cmd OR *\\pnpm.cmd) @Image:(*\\python.exe OR *\\Python.exe OR *\\PYTHON.EXE OR *\\pythonw.exe) @CommandLine:(*MetaMask* OR *metamask* OR *Solana* OR *solana* OR *Exodus* OR *exodus* OR *Phantom* OR *phantom* OR *"Login Data"* OR *"Local State"* OR *"Chrome\\User Data"* OR *"Edge\\User Data"* OR *Keychain* OR *keystore*)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ParentBaseFileName=/^(node\.exe|npm\.cmd|npx\.cmd|yarn\.cmd|pnpm\.cmd)$/i
| ImageFileName=/\\python(w)?\.exe$/i
| regex("(?i)(metamask|solana|phantom|exodus|Login Data|Local State|Chrome\\\\User Data|Edge\\\\User Data|Keychain|keystore)", field=CommandLine)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ParentImageFileName, ImageFileName], function={ count(as=execs) | min(@timestamp, as=firstSeen) | max(@timestamp, as=lastSeen) })
| sort(lastSeen, order=desc)
ucs.rationale: The node→python parent/child relationship combined with a hard-coded list of wallet/browser artifact paths is the published kill chain for BeaverTail (npm-borne JS loader) handing off to InvisibleFerret (Python stealer). This pair is unique to Famous Chollima / Contagious Interview campaigns — no benign developer workflow has npm spawning Python that opens Chrome's Login Data alongside MetaMask/So

ucs.title: [LLM] Famous Chollima DPRK IT-worker — unsanctioned RMM (AnyDesk / RustDesk / Chrome Remote Desktop) on developer endpoint correlated with anonymi
ucs.description: Hunts the DPRK fraudulent-IT-worker pattern (Famous Chollima / Wagemole / Microsoft 'Storm-1877') where the threat actor — posing as a remote developer — installs or sideloads consumer remote-management tools (AnyDesk, RustDesk, Chrome Remote Desktop, ScreenConnect) on a corporate workstation and accesses Entra ID from anonymizing infrastructure (Astrill VPN, residential proxy) typical of operators based in DPRK or China.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as firstSeen max(_time) as lastSeen values(Processes.process) as cmdlines values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parents from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("AnyDesk.exe","anydesk.exe","TeamViewer.exe","RustDesk.exe","rustdesk.exe","ScreenConnect.WindowsClient.exe","ScreenConnect.ClientService.exe","chrome_remote_desktop_host.exe","remoting_host.exe","UltraViewer_Desktop.exe") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name | `drop_dm_object_name("Processes")` | where NOT match(user,"\$$") AND user!="SYSTEM" | join type=inner user [ | tstats summariesonly=t count as signins values(Authentication.src) as src_ip values(Authentication.app) as apps from datamodel=Authentication where Authentication.action=success AND (Authentication.app="*AzureActiveDirectory*" OR Authentication.app="*Office365*") by Authentication.user Authentication.src | rename Authentication.user as user Authentication.src as signin_ip | lookup ip_threat_intel ip AS signin_ip OUTPUT category proxy_type asn_owner | search proxy_type IN ("vpn","residential_proxy","tor","anonymizer") OR asn_owner IN ("*Astrill*","*M247*","*ColocrossNet*") OR category="anonymizer" ] | table firstSeen lastSeen dest user process_name cmdlines signin_ip apps asn_owner | sort - lastSeen
ucs.kql:
// Famous Chollima DPRK IT-worker: RMM install on dev endpoint + sign-in from anonymizer within 24h
let RmmProcs = dynamic([
    "AnyDesk.exe","TeamViewer.exe","RustDesk.exe",
    "ScreenConnect.WindowsClient.exe","ScreenConnect.ClientService.exe",
    "chrome_remote_desktop_host.exe","remoting_host.exe",
    "UltraViewer_Desktop.exe","ConnectWiseControl.Client.exe"
]);
let SuspectGeos = dynamic(["KP","CN","RU","IR","LA"]);
let RmmEvents = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(14d)
    | where FileName in~ (RmmProcs)
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | project ProcessTime = Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, RmmTool = FileName, ProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessFileName;
let RiskySignIns = AADSignInEventsBeta
    | where Timestamp > ago(14d)
    | where ErrorCode == 0
    | where IsAnonymousProxy == true
        or Country in (SuspectGeos)
        or RiskLevelDuringSignIn in ("medium","high")
    | project SignInTime = Timestamp, AccountUpn, IPAddress, Country, City, IsAnonymousProxy, RiskLevelDuringSignIn, Application;
RmmEvents
| join kind=inner RiskySignIns on $left.AccountName == $right.AccountUpn
| where abs(datetime_diff('hour', ProcessTime, SignInTime)) <= 24
| project ProcessTime, SignInTime, DeviceName, AccountName, RmmTool,
          ProcessCommandLine, IPAddress, Country, City,
          IsAnonymousProxy, RiskLevelDuringSignIn, Application
| order by ProcessTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// Famous Chollima DPRK IT-worker: RMM install correlated with risky Entra sign-in
let RmmNames = dynamic([
    "AnyDesk.exe","TeamViewer.exe","RustDesk.exe",
    "ScreenConnect.WindowsClient.exe","ScreenConnect.ClientService.exe",
    "chrome_remote_desktop_host.exe","remoting_host.exe",
    "UltraViewer_Desktop.exe","ConnectWiseControl.Client.exe"
]);
let SuspectGeos = dynamic(["KP","CN","RU","IR","LA"]);
let RmmRuns = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | extend BinName = tostring(split(NewProcessName, "\\")[-1])
    | where BinName in~ (RmmNames)
    | where TargetUserName !endswith "$"
    | extend Upn = iif(TargetUserName contains "@", TargetUserName, strcat(TargetUserName, "@", TargetDomainName))
    | project ProcessTime = TimeGenerated, Computer, BinName, CommandLine, TargetUserName, Upn;
let RiskySignIns = SigninLogs
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
    | where ResultType == 0
    | extend Country = tostring(LocationDetails.countryOrRegion),
             City    = tostring(LocationDetails.city)
    | where Country in (SuspectGeos)
        or RiskLevelDuringSignIn in ("medium","high")
        or RiskState == "atRisk"
    | project SignInTime = TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, IPAddress, Country, City,
              RiskLevelDuringSignIn, AppDisplayName;
RmmRuns
| join kind=inner RiskySignIns on $left.Upn == $right.UserPrincipalName
| where abs(datetime_diff('hour', ProcessTime, SignInTime)) <= 24
| project ProcessTime, SignInTime, Computer, Upn, BinName, CommandLine,
          IPAddress, Country, City, RiskLevelDuringSignIn, AppDisplayName
| order by ProcessTime desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @Image:(*\\AnyDesk.exe OR *\\anydesk.exe OR *\\ANYDESK.EXE OR *\\TeamViewer.exe OR *\\teamviewer.exe OR *\\RustDesk.exe OR *\\rustdesk.exe OR *\\ScreenConnect.WindowsClient.exe OR *\\ScreenConnect.ClientService.exe OR *\\chrome_remote_desktop_host.exe OR *\\Chrome_remote_desktop_host.exe OR *\\remoting_host.exe OR *\\UltraViewer_Desktop.exe OR *\\ConnectWiseControl.Client.exe) -@User:*$
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ImageFileName=/(anydesk|teamviewer|rustdesk|screenconnect\.windowsclient|screenconnect\.clientservice|chrome_remote_desktop_host|remoting_host|ultraviewer_desktop|connectwisecontrol\.client)\.exe$/i
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| join({
    #event_simpleName=IdpAuthenticationLog
    | EventOutcome=Success
    | regex("(?i)(KP|CN|RU|IR|LA)", field=GeoCountry)
  }, field=UserPrincipal, key=UserPrincipal, include=[GeoCountry, RemoteAddressIP4, ApplicationName])
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ImageFileName, GeoCountry, RemoteAddressIP4], function={ count(as=hits) | min(@timestamp, as=firstSeen) | max(@timestamp, as=lastSeen) })
| sort(lastSeen, order=desc)
ucs.rationale: Famous Chollima's defining tradecraft (per Mandiant UNC5267, CrowdStrike, KnowBe4, and Microsoft Storm-1877 reporting) is the fraudulent-IT-worker scheme: the operator legitimately holds the user's credentials, so the only behavioral tell is (a) unsanctioned consumer RMM on a developer endpoint and (b) the Entra ID sign-in originating from Astrill-VPN / residential proxies / DPRK-friendly geos wit
